newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 5.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers plunged and were expected to weaken further on the back of softer cargoes despite tight supplies. Bunker 180cst was offered at $117-$120, down from Wednesday's $124/$128 with 380cst quoted $4 lower. Trade was reported at $120 for 180 cst and $202.50 for MDO. MDO fell to $196-202 and gas oil at $209-213, down from Thursday's quotes of $205-$215 and $215-$225 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703086)
